Inbar Axelrod Thank you so much for your answer. I just have a few more questions, sorry for asking so many.
If the translation is done in Israel, what would be the correct order? Should I get all my documents in Peru, have them apostilled, send them to Israel, and then have them translated and notarized there?

Thank you very much for your help! 🙏😊
